items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: INTERVIEWER: You say Lorenzo Senior is the one that taught... [INTERVIEWEE] Lorenzo did more teaching than... Louie.

ctx.x: I'll tell you another boy who's a product of that school, too, Buster Bailey. Oh, yes. Yeah.
You say Lorenzo Senior is the one that taught...

Lorenzo did more teaching than... Louie. And Louie, during his younger days, did a lot of traveling. You see, in the old days, we had minstrel troops. And we had... Companies that traveled the country, just like the show that we have now. And they carried their own orchestras and band. And Louie went in for that type of thing for a number of years. But Lorenzo always stayed right in New Orleans. He never did much traveling.
